hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), spectrogram reproduces scipy.signal.spectrogram (symmetric Hann, nperseg=256, noverlap=128, detrend=False, scaling='density', mode='psd') BIT-FOR-BIT over the full frequency x time matrix; and the time-frequency view shows the alpha rhythm dominates every time window (peak power in 8-13 Hz throughout) while its amplitude waxes and wanes across time (a modulation the averaged Welch PSD cannot show).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: the spectrogram equals scipy.signal.spectrogram to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) over all 129 x 11 cells, AND the peak-power frequency is in the alpha band in every time window
